:::{#exm-binomial-coefficient-not}
#### Ordered pairs are not subsets
<!-- no-figure: a short list of pairs; nothing to plot -->

The [set](#def-set) $\set{a, b, c}$ has $6$ [ordered pairs](#def-ordered-pair) of different elements:
$(a, b)$, $(b, a)$, $(a, c)$, $(c, a)$, $(b, c)$ and $(c, b)$.
That count is not $\binomial{3}{2}$,
because $(a, b)$ and $(b, a)$ are different pairs
but give the same [subset](#def-subset) $\set{a, b}$.
The [binomial coefficient](#def-binomial-coefficient) $\binomial{3}{2} = 3$ counts subsets,
which ignore order (@exm-binomial-coefficient).

:::
